comments.author: @antonis8780
comments.text:
What a waste of time... This is the epitome of cheap AI-generated content: so careless that it becomes misleading if not irrelevant. The video seems to have been uploaded without anyone watching it even once before uploading. It might well be a totally automated task, to create and upload.

The narration, about half the time is out of touch with what we're shown, or purely misleading. Where do I begin? The narration describes a traditionally dressed woman walking through the village of Inari, while the video shows a mixed-race young girl in high-tech clothing walking through a forest. We hear about tundra and moss as drone footage shows frozen forests. We’re told the lake freezes in winter, but shown a lake in the summer, as blue as the sky above it. The narration mentions traditional schools in northern Finland, while the footage shows an air-conditioned classroom—a feature non-existant in the region, in a school that has nothing to do with Finnish schools..

The same mismatch runs through the rest of the video. We hear about traditional Scandinavian fireplaces, but see oversized North American-style fireplaces from stock footage. American families decorate their homes in an extravagantly American style, which is the opposite of how Finns decorate for Christmas, and when the narration says Finns gather around the fireplace, we see North American scenes of children in socks reading “Canada.”

Then, at 16:44, the speaker says, “5.3 Lake Inari”—a fragment accidentally left in from the original script. It’s obvious nobody reviewed the video before publishing it. What a cheap production, irrespectful to its viewers...

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: We want to give you a direct and honest thank you, @antonis8780, for taking the time to write out such a thorough breakdown. We are taking your feedback directly to heart and completely overhauling our verification process to make sure our future documentaries hold up to genuine scrutiny.
